This repository is a Kotlin Multiplatform project for native D-Bus support. `src/commonMain/kotlin`: shared API + serialization. `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop`: Linux native implementation + C interop. `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}`: native tests + fixtures. `codegen/`: JVM CLI/library for XML-to-Kotlin code generation. `plugin/`: Gradle plugin (`com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin`) on top of `:codegen`. `compile_test/`: compile-time integration module for dependency wiring. `samples/bluez-scan/`: example consumer.

Use Gradle wrapper from repo root: `./gradlew build`, `./gradlew test`, `./gradlew ktlintCheck`, `./gradlew licenseCheck`, `./gradlew dokkaHtml`, `./gradlew codegen:fatJar`. CI release/docs: `gradle publish codegen:fatJar` and `gradle dokkaHtml` on Ubuntu.

Follow `.editorconfig`: 4-space indentation, LF endings, max line length 100. Kotlin style: `ktlint` (`android_studio` profile). Naming: `UpperCamelCase` classes, `lowerCamelCase` functions/properties, clear packages under `com.monkopedia.sdbus`.
